name: What is the typical cost range for bi-fold patio door installation?
description: Installation costs for bi-fold patio doors vary based on material, size, number of panels, and glass type, with custom options affecting the final price.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for bi-fold patio door installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of bi-fold patio door installation varies widely based on factors such as the door material (e.g., aluminum, wood, vinyl), the number of panels, size, glass type, and hardware. Custom sizes or specialized finishes can also increase the price. A preparation tip is to have precise measurements and an idea of your preferred materials before requesting a quote, as this will help us provide a more accurate estimate for your specific project in areas like Oakland or Piedmont.
